CustomField.description: The Salesforce file (ContentDocument Id) that holds the PDF of the respondent's answers sent with the confirmation email. The confirmation email flow fills it the first time it makes the PDF; each later PDF for this submission is saved as a new version of that same file, and the email carries the newest version. If the file has been deleted, the next PDF is saved as a new file and this field is updated to it. Set by the system; leave it alone.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The file that holds the PDF of the answers sent with the confirmation email. Each new PDF for this submission is saved as a new version of this file. Set automatically.
CustomField.label: Answers PDF Id
